name: Rune Ring
description: Black basalt, ember-cut runes, and a cold mystic wind signal.
notes: All layers use a centered 512 x 512 RGBA canvas. Cardinal letters are baked into the fixed ring; decorative runes carry no gameplay meaning. The ember rune-blade has 4.25x the opaque mass of the icy wind wisp.

orientationConventions.ring: Static north-up basalt card. N and the crowned rune index are baked at 12 o'clock.
orientationConventions.headingPointer: The large ember rune-blade points to 12 o'clock at heading 0. Its boss is centered at (0.5, 0.5); rotate it by pure player world bearing.
orientationConventions.windPointer: The slim icy wisp points to 12 o'clock at wind bearing 0. Its boss is centered at (0.5, 0.5); rotate it by pure wind-toward world bearing.
orientationConventions.lubberMarker: Optional static top accent for the north index. It does not replace the heading pointer.
